text: Went to the gym before work and did legs. My thighs are already sore but I feel strong.
Jogged a slow 5k along the river this morning. Lungs burning by the end, but I didn't stop once.
First yoga class at the community center. I couldn't touch my toes, the instructor said that's normal.
Skipped the gym again this week. Third time. I keep telling myself tomorrow.
Swam twenty laps at the pool after lunch, the water was freezing at first.

Long day. The printer jammed twice, a client call ran over, and I ate lunch at my desk staring at a spreadsheet. On the way home the bus was packed and someone's umbrella dripped on my shoes the whole ride. At least I squeezed in a bike ride at sunset, forty minutes up the hill and back, and my head finally went quiet.
Couldn't fall asleep until 3am. Kept replaying the meeting in my head.
Slept nine hours straight for the first time in months. Woke up before the alarm.
Woke up at 4:40 and just lay there staring at the ceiling until it got light.
Tried no screens after ten. Drifted off by eleven, which never happens.
Rent went up by 120 a month. I sat with the spreadsheet for an hour trying to make it work.
Paid off the last of the credit card today. Zero balance. I actually cheered in the kitchen.
Checked my bank account and winced. Too many takeaway orders this month.
Started putting 50 aside every payday into a separate pot.
Called Mom for an hour. She sounded tired but laughed at my story about the bus.
Mum and I argued about the holidays again. She wants everyone home, I can't afford the flight.
My mother sent a parcel with homemade jam and a note in her handwriting. I cried a bit.
Haven't spoken to mom in two weeks. I keep picking up the phone and putting it down.
Had the second interview with the design studio. They asked about a project I'm proud of and my mind went blank for a moment.
Got the offer! Starting salary is better than I hoped. Still deciding.
Rejection email from the agency this morning. Polite and short. Stings more than I expected.
Updated my CV and sent out four applications tonight.
Presentation to the whole department tomorrow. My hands were shaking just rehearsing.
The presentation went fine. Nobody noticed my voice wobble in the first minute.
My manager scheduled a quick chat for Friday with no agenda. Can't stop guessing what it's about.
Another twelve-hour day. I answered emails in bed. I don't remember the last weekend I didn't work.
I'm so tired of this job. Every morning I dread opening my laptop.
Took Biscuit to the vet, her ear infection is back. Drops twice a day for ten days.
Biscuit learned to sit on command after three weeks of trying. Proud dog parent moment.
Long walk with the dog through the park, she chased every single pigeon.
Sam cancelled on me for the third time this month. Starting to wonder if it's me.
Finally talked with Sam about the cancelled plans. Turns out they've been dealing with a lot at home. We hugged.
Dinner with Priya and Leo. We laughed so hard about the camping disaster that the waiter came over.
Packed up the kitchen into eleven boxes. The new flat gets the keys on Saturday.
First night in the new apartment. It echoes. I slept on the mattress on the floor and loved it.
Still living out of boxes two weeks after the move. Can't find the cheese grater.
Made dal from scratch using my grandmother's method. The whole flat smells of cumin.
Tried baking sourdough. It came out flat as a pancake but tasted great.
Cooked dinner for four people for the first time. Nobody got food poisoning.
Finished the novel about the lighthouse keeper. Stayed up past midnight for the last chapters.
Started a book on stoicism. Underlined half of the first chapter.
Weekend with no plans and nobody texted. The flat felt huge and quiet.
Everyone at the party seemed to know each other. I stood by the snacks most of the night.
Small perfect day: sun on the balcony, a long call with my sister. Nothing special and everything good.
Got a handwritten thank-you card from a student I tutored last year. Made my whole week.
Danced in the kitchen to old songs while dinner was on the stove. Felt like a kid again.
Third migraine this week. Lay in the dark with a cold cloth for most of the afternoon.
Doctor said my blood pressure is a little high. Need to cut back on salt.
Throat is scratchy and I've got a fever, calling in sick tomorrow.
Painted for two hours with watercolors. The sky came out muddy but the trees look alive.
Signed up for the evening ceramics course. First class is Tuesday.
Train to the coast. Ate chips on the pier while gulls circled. Salt in my hair all day.
Booked flights to Lisbon for October. First proper holiday in two years.
Spent the whole afternoon reorganizing my desk instead of writing the report. Classic.
The tax form has been sitting on the table for a month. Tomorrow. Definitely tomorrow.
Turned 30 today. Friends surprised me with a cake shaped like a cat.
Forgot Dad's birthday until 9pm. Called him, he pretended not to mind.
Jordan and I fought about the dishes, which wasn't really about the dishes.
Jordan surprised me with breakfast in bed. We stayed in our pajamas until noon.
We talked about moving in together. I'm excited and terrified in equal amounts.
The tomato plants on the balcony finally have flowers. Watering them is the best part of my morning.
Repotted the monstera, soil everywhere. It already looks happier.
Practiced for 30 minutes, my fingertips hurt. Finally got the F chord to ring clean.
Five coffees by 3pm. Jittery and couldn't focus anyway.
Day four without caffeine. The headache is finally fading.
Screen time report says 6 hours a day. Mostly scrolling. That's horrifying.
Left my phone at home all Sunday. Noticed so much more on my walk.
I feel empty at the end of every day. Like there's nothing left for me after work.
Took a mental health day. Did nothing and didn't feel guilty for once.
Heute war ich im Fitnessstudio und habe zum ersten Mal 60 Kilo gedrückt.
Ich habe schlecht geschlafen, schon wieder um vier Uhr wach.
Die Stromrechnung ist viel höher als erwartet. Ich muss diesen Monat sparen.
Der Bus war heute wieder zu spät, ich stand zwanzig Minuten im Regen.
Ich habe endlich das Bad geputzt und die Fenster gewaschen.
Anoche no pude dormir nada, me desperté cada hora.
Mi madre me llamó hoy, hablamos de la boda de mi prima.
Estoy preocupada por el dinero, el alquiler subió otra vez.
Hoy llovió todo el día y me quedé en casa viendo series.
J'ai couru dix kilomètres ce matin, je suis épuisée mais fière.
Je me sens seule depuis que Clara est partie à Lyon. Les soirées sont longues.
Il a plu toute la journée, j'ai rangé les placards.
最近よく眠れない。夜中に何度も目が覚める。
母と電話で話した。元気そうで安心した。
京都で一人旅。お寺を三つ回って、抹茶を飲んだ。
今日は雨で、一日中家にいた。
スーパーで野菜と牛乳を買った。
Comecei a aprender violão. Os dedos doem, mas já consigo tocar duas músicas.
Hoje choveu e fiquei em casa arrumando a cozinha.
